description: Agent-side OpenCode runtime (Abilityai/lilu#257 step 1), mirroring the Codex suite over the pure pieces of opencode_runtime.py; the subprocess is stubbed and `opencode` is never spawned. Load-bearing cases: an EMPTY FINAL TEXT IS A FAILED TURN (#520) — live on qwen3.6:27b via Ollama, which answers in a non-standard `reasoning` field with `content: ""` while reporting success, so exit 0 is not proof of a completed turn; the reasoning is never promoted into the response (a scratchpad is not an answer, and promoting it launders a failed turn into a plausible success), while a tool-only turn stays a success at "(Task completed)" for Codex parity. No cost double-count: `tokens.reasoning` ⊂ `tokens.output` and `tokens.cache.read` ⊂ `tokens.input`, both recorded separately and added to nothing; cost is NATIVE so a static check asserts no pricing table or `calculate_*` exists at all (#2207). Final text is the LAST step's text, not every text emitted. Error mapping: auth 503, rate 429, generic 500 (NOT 503 — that is the backend's AUTH signal and the dispatch breaker counts AUTH only), pipe drop 502, timeout 504, with anchored auth patterns so an incidental 401 in tool output is not read as the agent's credential failing. Factory resolves `opencode` case-insensitively (#1187 casing trap) and still RAISES on an unknown value. `provider/model` shape validated with a named 400 at the runtime boundary. Per-turn XDG_CONFIG_HOME carries the system prompt via `instructions:` (there is no system-prompt flag on `opencode run`, verified against the real --help), turn configs do not collide under parallel /api/task, cleanup unlinks rather than recursing into the symlinked provider tree, and a traversal-shaped execution_id cannot escape the turn root.
